g_rigid.basis: ASSUMED. Keyed handle in a keyed dock, taught pose. Between known-part bin picking 96-99 % (S2: pose error dominates) and wafer handlers ~1e-6-1e-7 per handoff (S1: hardware only, ideal objects).

r_rigid.basis: ASSUMED. Opening the jaws over a seated keyed object.

g_food_rigid.basis: SOURCED range: novel-object grasping 95-96 % (S3 Dex-Net 4.0, S4 QT-Opt), known parts 96-99 % (S2). Mid assumes a known firm item (potato, carrot, ginger) on a tray: 99.5 %.

g_food_soft.basis: SOURCED range: food acquisition 83-91 % on plates (S8 SPANet), human teleop demos of lettuce 94.7 % (S7). Mid 98.5 %.

g_food_wet.basis: SOURCED range: autonomous lettuce grasp 75 % (S7), slippery items the worst class in S8; wet pad friction unmeasured (#10). Mid 98 %.

g_food_small.basis: ASSUMED (+S8). Rib pieces, clams, cloves, okra, whole spices, one at a time.

r_food.basis: ASSUMED. Food let go into a chute, cradle, cup or plate: sticks to wet fingers, bounces out.

seat.basis: ASSUMED. Keyed seat with lead-in. Learned precise insertion reaches 100/100 (S5 HIL-SERL; one-sided 95 % bound >= 97 %). Tight reserves here: lid rack 0.3 mm, wok grasp 2.4 mm (R19_MOTION_LIBRARY 5).

contact_mech.basis: ASSUMED. Faucet lever, fridge door, drawer, lever-cutter stroke, cracker press. Learned-policy floor: cabinet 85 %, faucet rinse 80 % (S9).

stir_dice.basis: ASSUMED per 13.15 s cycle (5 strokes): jam, spatula turned in the grip, food thrown out. R15 rigid dice only.

stir_shred.basis: ASSUMED per cycle. README_R10:544: shreds and leaves "not credible" with rigid pieces.

food_contact.basis: ASSUMED. Spider scoop, re-push of an item under the lever blade, eggs out of the wok. Learned-policy floor: "cook shrimp" 60 % whole task (S9).

pour_liquid.basis: ASSUMED. Keyed cup tipped into a large target (wok, pot). Level accuracy 13-31 ml (S18) is dose error, not failure.

pour_food.basis: ASSUMED. Tip of food or paste: wok to plate, basket, spider dump, chopper bowl. Sim: 81-91 % of rigid dice on the plate, 98 % at half load (README_R10:561).

tool_change.basis: ASSUMED. Finger-set swap on a dovetail + spring pin, never simulated (R19_PREP_AUDIT 6.2).

appl_cmd.basis: ASSUMED. lo/mid: wired control with state read-back. hi: consumer smart plug, no read-back; forum reports of "a few percent" lost Zigbee commands (S17, anecdotal).

appl_proc.basis: ASSUMED. Outcome of a food-processing run: peel incomplete, slicer jam, piece stuck in the lever cutter, dry doser caked.

perc_struct.basis: ASSUMED. Presence / seated / flow / cup-ID check in a fixed scene; ~99.5 % detection on food lines (S14, vendor).

perc_food.basis: ASSUMED. Food localisation and food-state judgement (all out, peel done, shell-free).

transit.basis: ASSUMED. Protective stop on a hub transit (object left in the corridor, contact).

hw.basis: ASSUMED per meal: a fault of the arm, gripper, PC or station that needs the user (MTBF ~1,000 h of a home system).
